title: Design System: Texas, County by County

display.purpose: Place name heading the results panel; 1.875rem at 960px and below.

headline.purpose: The one-sentence answer under the heading.

body.purpose: Base text; tabular figures on by default.

label.purpose: Segmented-control options; 0.8125rem for map buttons, crumb, notice.

caption.purpose: Vote counts, legend, year ticks, source note (0.75rem to 0.6875rem).

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Resting floating pieces: legend, map controls, reset pill, error card.

shadows.name: shadow-toggle
shadows.purpose: Selected option in the segmented race switch.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared easing for transitions, panel crossfade, row re-rank, bars, peek.

motion.name: recolor-wave
motion.value: 700ms, ease-out cubic (1 - (1 - t)^3), west to east by county longitude
motion.purpose: Signature move: counties recolour when the election changes; instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: row-rerank
motion.purpose: Candidate rows keep identity by party and re-rank in place.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, background and shadow changes on controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: MotionConfig reducedMotion="user"; CSS transitions 0.01ms; wave, fitBounds and scrollIntoView skip animation

map.keyboard: Arrow keys step through counties alphabetically; Escape returns to all of Texas.

components.name: Segmented Race Switch
components.description: President / Senate / Governor radio group in the header; unavailable races dim and explain themselves.
components.css: .ds-offices { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; background: var(--lavender); border-radius: 999px; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-offices button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2); padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 999px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .25s var(--ease-out), color .25s var(--ease-out), box-shadow .25s var(--ease-out); } .ds-offices button:hover:not(.is-on):not(.is-off) { color: var(--ink); } .ds-offices button.is-on { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(42,37,51,.1); } .ds-offices button.is-off { color: var(--ink-3); opacity: .55; cursor: default; } .ds-offices button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pill Button
components.description: Floating map action, e.g. Show all of Texas.
components.css: .ds-pill { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-pill:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 36px circular close control in the mobile peek.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-btn" aria-label="Close county"><svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18"/><path d="m6 6 12 12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-btn { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-2); cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-btn:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--ground); } .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Crumb Link
components.description: Back to all of Texas, above the county heading; navigation, not a label.
components.html: <button class="ds-crumb"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 19-7-7 7-7"/><path d="M19 12H5"/></svg> All of Texas</button>
components.css: .ds-crumb { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; color: var(--lavender-ink); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-crumb:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-crumb:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Timeline Slider
components.description: Signature control: floating pill card with a native range input snapping to election years.
components.html: 2008201220182024
components.css: .ds-timeline { --thumb: 18px; width: 420px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px 22px 12px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-timeline input { -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none; display: block; width: 100%; height: var(--thumb); margin: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-timeline input::-webkit-slider-runnable-track { height: 4px; border-radius: 99px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--track-fill) var(--p), var(--lavender) var(--p)); } .ds-timeline input::-moz-range-track { height: 4px; border-radius: 99px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--track-fill) var(--p), var(--lavender) var(--p)); } .ds-timeline input::-webkit-slider-thumb { -webkit-appearance: none; width: var(--thumb); height: var(--thumb); margin-top: -7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface); border: 2px solid var(--focus); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(42,37,51,.16); transition: transform .2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-timeline input:active::-webkit-slider-thumb { transform: scale(1.12); } .ds-timeline input:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-timeline input:focus-visible::-webkit-slider-thumb { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--surface), 0 0 0 5px var(--focus); } .ds-ticks { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 8px; } .ds-ticks span { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-3); cursor: pointer; } .ds-ticks span:hover, .ds-ticks span.is-on { color: var(--ink); } .ds-ticks span.is-on { font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Candidate Row
components.description: Name, party dot and party, light percentage, vote count, and a party-colour bar; winner gets a lavender Won chip.
components.html:
Beto O'RourkeDemocratWon
74.3%359,772 votes
components.css: .ds-cand { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 8px 12px; width: 336px; color: var(--ink); font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1; font-family: var(--font); } .ds-cand-name { display: block; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-cand-party { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--ink-3); margin-top: 2px; } .ds-swatch { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-won { margin-left: 4px; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--lavender-ink); background: var(--lavender); border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 8px; } .ds-cand-nums { text-align: right; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-cand-pct { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-cand-votes { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-cand-bar { grid-column: 1 / -1; height: 4px; border-radius: 99px; background: var(--ground); overflow: hidden; } .ds-cand-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 99px; }

components.name: Legend
components.description: Map key: party by three margin steps, floating top-left on the map.
components.css: .ds-legend { margin: 0; display: inline-block; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 14px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--ink-2); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-legend-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto repeat(3, 36px); gap: 4px; align-items: center; } .ds-legend-grid > span { padding-right: 6px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-legend-grid i { display: block; height: 12px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-legend-grid small { font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--ink-3); text-align: center; } .ds-legend figcaption { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.6875rem; color: var(--ink-3); }

components.name: Map Tooltip
components.description: Hover card over a county: name, winner with party dot, margin.
components.html: Travis CountyO'Rourke (Democrat) +49.7 pts
components.css: .ds-tip { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; max-width: 260px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.4; border: 1px solid var(--hairline); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-tip strong { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-tip span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-tip em { font-style: normal; color: var(--ink-3); } .ds-tip .ds-swatch { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Mobile Peek
components.description: Fixed bottom sheet on phones showing the tapped county's answer.
components.css: .ds-peek { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 340px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--hairline); border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px 12px 12px 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift); font-family: var(--font); } .ds-peek-main { flex: 1; border: 0; background: none; padding: 0; text-align: left; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; color: var(--ink); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-peek-main strong { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-peek-main span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--ink-2); } .ds-peek-main em { font-style: normal; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--lavender-ink); } .ds-peek .ds-swatch { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-peek-main:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Quiet Pastel Map"**

Texas in soft rose and powder blue on a pale lilac field, with nothing on screen but the map, the result, and one slim timeline. The map owns the left of the screen; a white results panel holds the answer on the right; a floating pill slider sits along the bottom edge of the map. Everything that is not data is lilac, lavender, white or plum ink, so the party pastels are the only saturated colour you see.

It is calm and sleek rather than a busy election-night dashboard: light weights for big words and numbers, hairline borders, soft wide shadows, generous rounded corners. Density stays low. One answer at a time, written as a plain sentence ("Beto O'Rourke won Travis County by 49.7 points."), with exact counts underneath.

Motion is a single gesture. When the election changes, counties recolour in a soft west-to-east wave; candidate rows re-rank in place; the panel crossfades. All of it honours reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: Pale lilac-mist ground, white surfaces, plum ink for every text tone (AA on both).
Party pastels carry data and nothing else; lavender carries selection and state.
Geist Variable throughout: light for big words and numbers, medium for names, tabular figures for counts.
Hairline borders plus soft, wide, plum-tinted shadows on floating pieces only.
Pill and generously rounded shapes; no hard corners on interactive pieces.

rules.name: The Data-Only Pastel Rule
rules.body: Rose, powder blue, sand, butter, mint and haze mean a party and nothing else. Never use them for buttons, states, headings or decoration. Interface state is lavender and violet.

rules.name: The Text-Carries-Precision Rule
rules.body: Neighbouring margin steps are about 1.7–2.2:1 apart (darkened on owner request), so shade reads the margin band, but only roughly; the exact margin and vote counts are always available as text (panel, tooltip, peek). Any new surface that uses the shade steps must also give the exact number in text.

rules.name: The Plum-Only Text Rule
rules.body: All text uses the three plum ink tones or lavender ink. No grey, no pure black, no coloured text drawn from the party pastels.

rules.name: The Light-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Big numbers are set light (300) and large, never bold. Weight goes up only as size goes down.

rules.name: The Subtitle-Below Rule
rules.body: Context for a heading sits under it, never above it. The race and year ("U.S. Senate · 2018") follow the h2 as a subtitle; the only thing that may sit above the heading is the "All of Texas" back link, which is navigation, not a label. No eyebrows or kickers.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this sits on top of the map." Panels and the header in the layout stay flat with hairlines.

dos: **Do** keep every text tone to plum ink, plum ink 2, plum ink 3 or lavender ink, so all text passes AA on the lilac ground and on white.
**Do** use focus violet for focus rings and the slider thumb, and track violet only for the filled track, kept at 3:1 or better for non-text contrast.
**Do** pair every margin shade with the exact margin in text somewhere on the same path (panel, tooltip or peek).
**Do** set large numbers light (300) with tabular figures, and keep names at 500.
**Do** put a heading's context under it as a subtitle.
**Do** keep shadows on floating pieces only, using the soft and lift values.
**Do** make sure every new animation respects reduced motion, through Motion's `reducedMotion="user"` or the CSS override.
donts: **Don't** use party pastels for anything but party data: no rose or blue buttons, states, headings or decorative fills.
**Don't** put eyebrows or kickers above headings.
**Don't** add dashboard chrome (stat tiles, dense tables, extra toolbars) around the map; one answer at a time.
**Don't** use hard or offset shadows, or heavy borders; 1px hairlines only.
**Don't** add a second accent hue; interface state is lavender and violet.
**Don't** add motion beyond the wave, the in-place re-rank, the panel crossfade and the small state transitions.
